review:
Kitchen Drama: Sushi Mania is one of Nolimit City's very first slots, a 5x3 cascading game set in a sushi kitchen. Winning with three sushi ingredients is part of the free spins trigger, and the free spins can turn every ingredient wild.

Bunshin Wilds clone themselves onto two more positions, and three or more cascades activate Kamisabi Attack. With Medium volatility, a 96.77% RTP and a 697x cap, it's a gentle, family-friendly slot.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
